value.value: At your village, you decide to watch something. Will it be star wars or star trek? Would you like to pick star wars?

true.value: Storm trooper noises, jedi noises. Darth Vader breathes. There is a fighting scene. Fortunately, the good guys don't get hurt. It turns out it was a happy ending the whole time.

false.value: They Trek on the stars. There is a scene with an alien species. They encounter an issue with the aliens. Fortunately, they are able to work it out and there is a happy ending.

value.value: After you see the stars, you go to a bed. It is yours.
